# Nexa

> Nexa (NEKSA AMD DOOEL, Skopje, North Macedonia) builds Nexa Terminal — legal, HR and compliance tools plus a business social network for small and medium-sized companies, free forever for SMEs — and provides consulting and project management for complex business projects (real estate due diligence, M&A, startups, organisational development, market entry). Content is general information, not legal advice; legal opinions are issued by licensed partner lawyers.

Primary language is Macedonian; every page also has an English version at the same URL with `?lang=en`. Full text of the key pages: https://nexa.mk/llms-full.txt

## Nexa Terminal (software)
- [Nexa Terminal — overview and plans](https://nexa.mk/): documents from 45+ templates, AI assistants, compliance checks, HR tools, business social network. Basic plan is free forever for SMEs; Pro is invite-only for lawyers.
- [Plans](https://nexa.mk/#paketi)
- [Free sign-up](https://nexa.mk/login?mode=register)
- [Free compliance check (15 questions)](https://nexa.mk/proverka)
- [“Verified employer” badge](https://nexa.mk/proverka-rabotodavac)
